transcribedBy: opus-agent gap hunt conflicts + blind re-read

fills.name: Folkekirken
fills.quote: FOLKEKIRKEN Economic Technology 900 45s Unique to Vikings Increases population and maximum population by +10. | KONGENS DØR CATHEDRAL Age IV - Economic Landmark
fills.note: The tech is only in the Kongens Dør Cathedral's panel. That building is the Age IV landmark and exists only once the player is Imperial, so no frame can show a Requirements line. The in-game Tech Tree (BV1Bmnx6ZEBh_p1 s_03148, 52:28) puts the Folkekirken icon in the Age IV row under the cathedral. The datamined age 3 / Castle can never apply in play.

fills.name: Snowdoun Gate
fills.variant: Highland Archer toggle, c_oaynL66jY player's production-speed bonuses (toggle OFF, static)
fills.quote: HIGHLAND ARCHER Light Ranged Infantry, Highland Warrior 52s | SNOWDOUN GATE Age III - Military Landmark, Lowlands
fills.note: Read 10 s after completion. Toggle tooltips at 20:10-20:14 say MEN-AT-ARMS / CATERAN / HIGHLAND ARCHER PRODUCTION (OFF). 76/52 = 1.46, so roughly +45% speed. The Pikeman reading in the same game (53s, 2 s into its cycle at s_01209) also fits about 55 s = 80/1.45.

fills.name: Snowdoun Gate
fills.variant: Highland Archer toggle, wzT5WTqIIU4 player's production-speed bonuses (countdown snapshot)
fills.quote: HIGHLAND ARCHER Light Ranged Infantry, Highland Warrior 57s | SNOWDOUN GATE Age III - Military Landmark, Lowlands
fills.note: These tooltips count down: Early MAA reads 1m19s then 1m17s two game-seconds later (s_00522, s_00524), and Cateran reads 1m4s then 1m3s. The streamer reads 58 s for the archer at 08:47-08:51. The four readings (MAA 1m20s, Cateran 1m5s, archer 58s) are base/1.3, so about +30% speed. The 58 candidate is this cycle before the first second ticks off.

fills.name: Adjustable Crossbars
fills.quote: ADJUSTABLE CROSSBARS Mangonel Technology 1000 1200 59s | SIEGE WORKSHOP Military Building
fills.note: 59s is the time left on a research already running, not a discount. The tech's button in the Siege Workshop panel is greyed with a progress bar about one third full. 'Adjustable Crossbars completed' appears at game 02:13, exactly 60 s after this frame (game 01:13; s_00812 at 13:32 still shows the banner). Remaining 59-60 s at one third progress gives a total of about 90 s, which matches the datamined 90.
fills.tieReason: Adjustable Crossbars tooltip at the Siege Workshop clearly reads 1000 wood, 1200 gold, 59s. Reader A's 90 contradicts its own quote, which says 59s.

fills.name: Villager
fills.quote: VILLAGER Worker 22s Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units. - Weak in combat
fills.note: Northern Migration auto-recruit timer. At game 00:43 (s_00124) the tooltip reads 01s with villagers 7/10. At 00:44 it resets to 22s and villagers show 8/10, so the full cycle is 22 s. The tooltip shows no food cost.

fills.name: Bondi
fills.quote: BONDI Light Melee Infantry 75 25 17s Unique to Vikings | BARRACKS Military Building
fills.note: Barracks. The same 17s shows in BV1djnt6oETG_p1 (t=215) and BV182n46EEDi_p1, so it is a static value, not a countdown.

fills.name: Bondi
fills.quote: BONDI Light Melee Infantry 75 25 23s Unique to Vikings | LONGHOUSE Population Building
fills.note: Same player, 37 s after the Barracks reading. 17/0.75 = 22.7, which rounds to 23. The same 23s shows at Longhouses in ehO1BOe7wG8, uNw-K34ZDPs, BV1djnt6oETG_p1, BV1Yfnx6nEZM_p1 and qARfRxyhRhA.

fills.name: Danevirke
fills.quote: DANEVIRKE Defensive Technology 500 45s Unique to Vikings Converts Palisades to Danevirke walls, which have +1000 increased health and 5 fire armor. Requirements: Castle Age (III) | TOWN CENTER
fills.note: Danevirke walls only exist after this Castle-Age tech, or after Valdemar Castle (an 'Age III - Defensive Landmark' that 'Grants the Danevirke technology'; uNw-K34ZDPs s_01440). Walls seen only in Age III or later: ehO1BOe7wG8 s_01276 'Danevirke completed' with Corvinus1 Age III; qARfRxyhRhA s_00592 with the Vikings player at III. The datamined building record says age 1 only because it replaces a palisade.

fills.name: Danevirke Gate
fills.quote: DANEVIRKE GATE Defensive Building 2350/2350 | unc | Age III
fills.note: The gate must sit on a Danevirke wall segment (datamined description), and those walls need the Castle Age (III) Danevirke tech. In Age I the same player's gate is a PALISADE GATE (nd74LibluQ0 s_00776, 12:56).

fills.name: Dreki Stave Church
fills.quote: I Q | II W | III E | IV R
fills.note: In the Vikings villager build menu (player in Age II), the only icon under 'IV R' is a greyed unique-civ stave-church icon. It matches the selection portrait for 'DREKI STAVE CHURCH Wonder' (nd74LibluQ0 s_02526, 42:06). That wonder was placed at game 55:41 with 'unc | Age IV' (nd74LibluQ0 s_02499). No tooltip naming it with a Requirements line was found.

fills.name: Guardian of Scotland
fills.quote: GUARDIAN OF SCOTLAND Wonder 5000 5000 5000 5000 10m 0s Unique to Scots Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory.
fills.note: The hovered icon sits in the build-menu column whose header reads 'IV R'. The header is visible two seconds later in s_02440 (40:40) once the tooltip closes. There is no Requirements line because the player is already Age IV.

fills.name: Vegetable Farm
fills.quote: VEGETABLE FARM Food Source, Building 300/300 | Farmstead completed | unc | Age I
fills.note: The fields come from the Longhouse Farmstead attachment. Its tooltip in Age I has no Requirements line ('FARMSTEAD Longhouse Upgrades 200 02s', BV182n46EEDi_p1 s_01673).

fills.name: Northern Migration
fills.quote: NORTHERN MIGRATION Information Villagers are automatically recruited at no cost as long as there is spare Villager Capacity. Villager Capacity is increased by constructing more Longhouses. | 6/10
fills.note: Starting Villager Capacity is 10 (Capital Town Center, no Longhouses). The HUD counter next to the Northern Migration icon reads 6/10 at game 00:10, and population is shown separately as 7/10. With one Longhouse it reads 15/20 (uNw-K34ZDPs 30:24, pop 16/35). The highest capacity seen is 200 (nd74LibluQ0 43:43 '72/200'; BV1Yfnx6nEZM_p1 '120/200'). No frame states a hard maximum.

fills.name: Northern Migration (detail)
fills.quote: NORTHERN MIGRATION Information ... Villager Capacity is increased by constructing more Longhouses. | 6/10
fills.note: Same reading as 'Northern Migration' cap: base capacity 10, plus 10 per Longhouse.
